about: The canon-anchor registry (D's half of the campaign submit gate, 2026-11-05; ruled 2026-10-15 in docs/State/health_check.md). Written ONLY by hand (this first transcription) or by `scripts/anchors_registry.py add` — never by a submit. Each entry records an arm0 canon, the image it was produced on, its window, and the sha256 (core.substrate_stamp.manifest_digest) of the COMMITTED config/substrate_manifest.sha256 it was measured under. The gate refuses an anchor whose digest is not the current pinned manifest's. Entries are never edited or removed: a re-run on a new substrate is a NEW entry; the old stays as history. The four initial entries are transcribed from docs/Audit prose with the source cited; each canon_md5 is to be reproduced by the reviewer before the file is trusted. As of re-pin #1 (manifest 48da855eda024bfe785a114ebfeab6ce9f0f1da02ebe2a4fdd4fd88085dfdb96, 2026-11-05) NO entry is current: every multi-arm submit citing one of these anchors refuses until the re-anchor adds new entries.

It is the T-167 manifest (commit bd68438), NOT the 2026-06-18 T-219 manifest (4b34ea82…, the one at 1d116c5) — two re-pins (T-175 simfin panel, T-215/T-219 cap files) separate them.
